The text contains both objective and subjective elements. The statement "Many scientists agree that climate change is exacerbated by human activity" is an objective fact, as it reports a verifiable consensus within the scientific community. However, the phrase "there are still some dissenting voices" introduces a subjective nuance by highlighting disagreement, though it remains factually grounded in the existence of those dissenters. Overall, the text leans toward objective reporting of scientific opinion.
